title: Refresh and retain audited release dependency lock
description: RustSec audit of existing local dependency lock found rustls 0.23.45 affected by RUSTSEC-2026-0346 through 0349; update to patched >=0.23.46, retain Cargo.lock for reproducible CLI release checks, and re-run advisories plus full tests. Assess actual enabled-feature exposure rather than claiming all advisory paths are reachable. Transitive tokenizers uses unmaintained paste (RUSTSEC-2024-0436), with no safe upstream upgrade reported; record as maintenance follow-up, not hidden suppression.

comments.author: example-user
comments.text: Updated rustls lock entry from 0.23.45 to 0.23.46. Official RustSec recheck has zero vulnerability diagnostics; unmaintained paste remains an explicit warning with follow-up BOTSPY-fe4535. Cargo.lock now retained for repeatable CLI package verification. Full tests/lint/docs running.
